nvitk.morphology._common¶

Internal helpers for the nvitk.morphology module.

Functions¶

_as_array(→ Any)

Unwrap an Image to its voxel array; pass raw arrays through.

_wrap_like(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Re-wrap data as an Image when original was one; else return data.

_coerce_to_current_backend(→ Any)

Move arr onto the currently-selected NumPy/CuPy backend.

_iterate_structure_hostside(→ Any)

Run scipy.ndimage.iterate_structure() on NumPy then move back.

make_ball_footprint(→ Any)

Return an ndi.generate_binary_structure-based ball of radius.

_resolve_structure(→ Any)

Produce the final structuring element for morphology ops.
